description: This file defines the SpecSchedule struct and related functions for scheduling tasks based on crontab-like specifications, including calculating the next activation time.

classes.name: SpecSchedule
classes.description: Represents a schedule with second, minute, hour, day of month, month, and day of week fields, along with a location for time zone.

classes.name: bounds
classes.description: Defines acceptable ranges and names for schedule fields such as seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, and days of week.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Calculates the next time the schedule is activated after a given time.

methods.name: dayMatches
methods.description: Checks if the given time matches the schedule's day-of-month and day-of-week restrictions.
